if.test: startDateTime != null and startDateTime != '' and endDateTime != null and endDateTime != ''

where.if: AND SENT_AT >= TO_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(#{startDateTime}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AND SENT_AT <= TO_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(#{endDateTime}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')

mapper.select:
SELECT h.ID, h.CAMPAIGN_NAME, h.SEND_TYPE, h.SENDER_NO, h.RECEIVER_NO, h.MESSAGE, h.SEND_STATUS, h.RESEND_YN, h.RESULT_CODE, h.RESULT_MESSAGE, (SELECT sl.TELECOM FROM SMS_SEND_LOG sl WHERE sl.RECEIVER_NO = h.RECEIVER_NO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS telecom, h.RESERVED_AT, h.SENT_AT, h.CREATED_AT, h.UPDATED_AT FROM SMS_HISTORY h
ORDER BY h.SENT_AT DESC, h.ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SMS_HISTORY (CAMPAIGN_NAME, SEND_TYPE, SENDER_NO, RECEIVER_NO, MESSAGE, SEND_STATUS) VALUES (#{campaignName}, #{sendType}, #{senderNo}, #{receiverNo}, #{message}, #{sendStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE SMS_HISTORY SET SEND_STATUS = #{sendStatus}, RESULT_CODE = #{resultCode}, RESULT_MESSAGE = #{resultMessage}, SENT_AT = #{sentAt}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id}
